This application coming on for admission this day, the court passed the
following:
 Order

This is the second application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of bail relating to FIR No.605/2022 dated (not mentioned) registered at Police Station Police Chowki Sehora, Police Station Gadarwara, District Narsinghpur, for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 366-A, 376(1), 376(3), 376(D.A.) of Indian Penal Code and Sections 3, 4, 5-G and 6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

1 passed in M.Cr.C. No.50355 of 2022 granting liberty to revive the prayer of bail after recording the statement of the prosecutrix.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the applicant submits that the applicant is in jail since 05.07.2022.
He submits that after withdrawal of first bail application, the statement of prosecutrix got recorded in which she has not supported the case of prosecution and turned hostile.

He submits that in view of the above,
it is clear that the applicant is innocent and has been falsely implicated in the alleged offence.
Therefore, he prays that looking to the aforesaid facts and circumstances of the case and the applicant's custody period, he may be enlarged on bail.
On the other hand, learned Government Advocate has opposed the prayer of bail.

Considering the arguments advanced by learned counsel for the parties, perusal of case diary and the statement of prosecutrix in which she has not supported the case of prosecution and turned hostile, I am inclined to enlarge the applicant on bail.
Therefore, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, this application is allowed.

It is directed that the applicant be released on bail upon his furnishing a personal bond in the sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with one solvent surety of the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court concerned for his appearance on the dates given by it.
It is further directed that the applicant shall abide by the conditions enumerated in Section 437(3) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
Certified copy as per rules.

(SANJAY DWIVEDI) JUDGE Devashish DEVASHISH MISHRA 2023.06.22 10:33:58 +05'30'
